- `pull portfolio-health --file` command

- `My_Data/AGENTS.md` lines 75–87
- `The Research Spine/AGENTS.md` lines 37–49

changing automation-facing docs. Per project memory, that guide references

surfaces where present" (vague). When the A2A plan lands, the AGENTS.md guide

rules in `AGENTS.md` conflict with user-global rules, the project file should win

- **Make.md doesn't change Markdown** — it just renders frontmatter properties (`sticker`, `banner`, `color`) as visual UI on top of standard notes. So a "make.md template" is just a regular template note that uses those special properties; no plugin-specific syntax required.
